title: Ensure 'Disable HTTP proxy features: Disable WPAD' is set to 'Enabled: Checked'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Disable HTTP proxy features: Disable WPAD to 'Enabled: Checked'
reason: WPAD (Web Proxy Auto-Discovery) poses a significant security risk, as it allows attackers to perform Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks by spoofing the WPAD server response. Disabling it is highly recommended.
